speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin our investigation, how long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool appearance?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; the combination of "drenching" night sweats and significant weight loss over four weeks suggests a systemic process. Have you noticed any fevers, or have you experienced any changes in your appetite or taste? REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, LDH, ESR, and CRP.
